Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Clint Capela?

Clint Capela is 32 years old.

Where was Clint Capela born?

Clint Capela was born in Geneva, Switzerland.

When was Clint Capela born?

Clint Capela was born on May 18, 1994.

How tall is Clint Capela?

Clint Capela is 6-10 (208 cm) tall.

How much does Clint Capela weigh?

Clint Capela weighs 256 lbs (116 kg).

Is Clint Capela in the Hall of Fame?

Clint Capela is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Clint Capela drafted?

Clint Capela was drafted by Houston Rockets, 1st round (25th pick, 25th overall), 2014 NBA Draft.

What position does Clint Capela play?

Center.

What is Clint Capela's net worth?

Clint Capela has made at least $137,643,961 playing professional basketball.

How much does Clint Capela make?

Clint Capela made $22,265,280 in 2025.

How many rings does Clint Capela have?

Clint Capela has won 0 championships.

What is Clint Capela's Instagram account?

Clint Capela is on Instagram at ccapela15.

What are Clint Capela's nicknames?

Swiss Bank is a nickname for Clint Capela.
